The assistant uses the model: it chooses a tool, the tool runs as the caller, the model writes the answer
A model that fails does not break the assistant: the person still gets an answer from their own data
Guardrails still apply when a model is connected
A repair photo is read by the model and comes back as a triage

Every call is audited with who asked and what the model was used for

Other topics read naturally, and a bot or a refused form notifies nobody
An enquiry on a home notifies the leasing agents, an application notifies the managers, a tour request notifies the managers
The monthly run bills each company once: units times the plan price, never under the minimum, and running it again changes nothing
A company sees only its own invoices and can pay by card: a declined card changes nothing, a part payment leaves a balance, paying the rest settles it
The operator records a wire, a cheque or a credit, raises a one-off charge, and cannot void an invoice that has money against it
The operator\'s summary adds up, and everything is closed to company people
Every service reports its health, and only the platform administrator can ask
Company usage lists each customer with who signed in, and can be filtered, sorted and searched
The delivery log shows messages for every company with the company named, and is closed to everyone else
For support work one message can be opened in full with a reason, and the company can see in its audit log that it was

An owner reads the ratings of their own properties only, and a resident reads only their own rating

Closing a repair with a rating also files it with the vendor\'s other ratings
Every report answers a summary and rows for a manager, in the same shape
Portfolio figures add up: the summary matches the rows, occupancy is occupied over units, a gap is market minus rent
Tables can be sorted, searched and filtered by column, and the choices are checked

Each person gets the reports for their role: owners their own properties, residents and vendors none

From a new company to a resident moving out, with every person signed in

The repair-photo tool shows the triage the model produced
